name: SM_Cabin_Window_PR

textures.channels: tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

material_exception: unique BC/N/ORM bake private to this asset (not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2): the task for the unclaimed families asks for a baked set per asset, and the surface detail here (see dresses) does not exist in the shared library
pivot: base centre (bbox centre in X/Y, mesh bottom at z = 0), front on -Y
dresses: small cabin window, 72 x 84 cm: squared timber frame, sill and mullion, leaded diamond quarries of dark blue-grey glass
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound in families.json
known_weaknesses: The glass is an opaque dark panel with the lead lattice painted and bumped on it: no transmission, so nothing shows through and it cannot glow at night without an emissive map. Quarry tilt is a normal-map effect. Boards are bevelled blocks butted together: no joints, pegs, nails or tool marks are modelled, and the grain is procedural streaking, not a scan. Every board is 12 triangles in the game mesh, so edge rounding is in the normal map only. It is a loose window for a log wall; the wall belongs to the log cabin family.
